description: Nigeria Primary and Secondary Roads (data from OSM) is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Nigeria. Nigeria Roads (Primary and Secondary roads. Data from OSM). Coverage: Nigeria. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Nigeria. Its tags are geodata, roads. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-04-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODC-ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
